summary: Iter-73 Salla Direct Phase-2 (UI-managed OAuth + Sync + Sources Comparison) — full backend verification. 16 NEW review-driven tests + 9 existing iter73 unit tests + 18 regression tests (iter68 payment-method idempotency + iter72 shipping companies + reconciliation phase22) = 51/51 PASS. All 14 items from the review_request are explicitly covered and green. No defects found.
critical_code_review_comments: routes.py /status uses integration_to_public(doc) which by construction never echoes access_token/refresh_token — verified test_status_does_not_leak_tokens.

routes.py /config GET intentionally omits the raw client_secret and only exposes has_client_secret bool — good. The shape now includes the four env_*_present flags that the UI needs to render the 'env fallback' badges.

config_store.save_config correctly treats an empty/None client_secret as 'no change' so the UI 'Save' button works for client_id-only updates without forcing the merchant to re-enter the secret. Verified by test_config_put_without_secret_preserves_existing.
routes.py put_config validates client_id with .strip() before length check — empty string returns 400 with Arabic message 'Client ID مطلوب.' as required.

After PUT /config, the in-process credentials cache is reloaded via update_credentials_cache(...) — confirmed by test_oauth_login_200_after_config_saved which sees authorize_url immediately on the very next request without a restart.
routes.py /oauth/login HTTPException 503 detail message is in Arabic and instructs the merchant where to obtain Client ID/Secret — matches UX spec.

routes.py /sync/orders + /sync/products both wrap SallaError into HTTPException with detail={message, needs_reauth} — the frontend can therefore reliably switch UI to 'Reconnect Salla' state. Both branches verified.

compute_sources_comparison returns all 8 by_combination keys (make_only/excel_only/salla_only/make_and_salla/excel_and_salla/make_excel_and_salla/make_and_excel/unknown) — full coverage matrix, no missing combination. per_source_totals keys (make/excel/salla_direct) present.

orders_db._merge_into honours the fills_empty_only contract when source='salla_direct' and an existing make-tagged field is present — confirmed both via unit test (test_merge_rule_unit_does_not_overwrite_make) AND the existing test_salla_direct_does_not_overwrite_make_critical_fields. Make.com remains authoritative as required by the merchant.
disconnect endpoint is idempotent (returns ok:true even when nothing was removed). Two consecutive calls succeed — important because the frontend re-issues this on retry.
Regression — /api/reconciliation/summary still returns the full totals structure with non-negative expected; Phase-2 changes did not affect Phase-1 reconciliation math.
Regression — POST /api/accounts/sync-payment-methods still returns 200 with a structured body; merge changes did not break the canonical-account sync.

Minor (non-blocking): /salla/oauth/login still references SALLA_CLIENT_ID/SECRET in .env in its Arabic 503 message even though the UI flow is now the primary path. Consider updating the message to direct the merchant to Settings → Salla in the UI. Functional correctness is fine.
Minor (non-blocking): routes.py defines `class SallaConfigIn: pass` placeholder that is never used — dead code, can be removed.

success_rate.backend: 100% (51/51 — 16 new + 9 existing iter73 + 8 iter68 + 10 iter72 + 8 reconciliation)

context_for_next_testing_agent: Phase-2 is fully green and production-safe. The next testing iteration likely targets either (a) the actual OAuth callback with a real Salla sandbox merchant (requires valid Client ID/Secret in /config + visiting the authorize_url in a browser — outside CI scope), or (b) the Sources Comparison UI screen. The merge protection invariant (salla_direct never overwrites make-tagged fields in total_amount/order_status/payment_method) is covered by two independent tests — preserve them. The merchant's real .env still has SALLA_CLIENT_ID/SECRET EMPTY so any future test that assumes /oauth/login returns 200 without first PUT /config will FAIL — always PUT then test then DELETE.
rca of the issue: N/A — no defects found. All 51 tests pass on first run against the live preview backend (https://salla-analytics.preview.emergentagent.com). The fills_empty_only protection in orders_db._merge_into correctly keeps Make.com authoritative as required by the merchant. The UI-managed OAuth credentials flow works end-to-end: empty config → 503 → PUT /config → cache reload in-process → /oauth/login returns valid authorize URL → DELETE /config restores empty state for next test.
